map.patience 表示验证指标连续多少轮未改善即停止，用于防止过拟合。: patience is how many consecutive rounds without improvement in the validation metric are allowed before stopping, which prevents overfitting.
map.patience 设多大合适？: What Is a Good patience Value?
map.patience 过小易早停漏掉后期收敛，过大则浪费算力，常用 5~20。: Too small a patience stops early and misses later convergence, while too large wastes compute; 5 to 20 is common.
map.→ 打开早停耐心估算工具: -> Open the Early Stopping Patience Estimator tool
map.取决于训练曲线波动。噪声大(如小 batch)需更大 patience 避免误停: It depends on the fluctuation of the training curve. With heavy noise (such as a small batch) a larger patience is needed to avoid stopping early, while smooth training can use a smaller value. A common choice is 10%~20% of the total epochs.
map.早停参数估算器，根据训练速度估算 patience 与预计总训练时间，辅助深度学: An early-stopping parameter estimator that computes patience and the expected total training time from the training speed, supporting early-stopping strategy design and compute planning for deep learning training.
map.早停后要不要回退到最优轮？: Should You Roll Back to the Best Epoch After Early Stopping?
map.早停用\"连续多少轮验证指标未改善就停止\"防止无效训练与过拟合。耐心值太小会在: Early stopping uses "stop after N consecutive rounds without validation improvement" to prevent wasted training and overfitting. A patience that is too small ends training early on the plateau (the validation loss often oscillates before falling), while too large wastes compute; 5–20 rounds is typical, and it should be converted into an acceptable waiting cost based on the time per round.
map.早停等待时间(分钟) = 耐心轮数 × 单轮时长 / 60；最大建议轮数 = 最: Early-stopping wait time (minutes) = patience rounds × time per round / 60; maximum recommended rounds = minimum rounds + patience × 3
map.要。监控最佳验证权重并单独保存(model checkpoint)，停止后加载该: Yes. Monitor the best validation weights and save them separately (a model checkpoint), and after stopping load that checkpoint rather than the last epoch, otherwise you may be using already overfitted weights.
map.预计总时长≈(当前轮次+剩余耐心轮次)×单轮耗时，辅助算力排期。: The expected total duration ≈ (current epoch + remaining patience epochs) × time per epoch, which helps schedule compute resources.
map.：已训练 30 轮、单轮 4 分钟、patience=10。若验证已 10 轮未: : with 30 epochs trained, 4 minutes per epoch and patience=10, if the validation has not improved for 10 epochs it should stop immediately; in the worst case another 10×4=40 minutes is needed. You can plan the GPU release ahead of time on this basis.
